description: Minimalist notes CLI in TypeScript. Serves as a didactic example of Harness Engineering.

features.name: storage_layer
features.title: JSON Storage Layer
features.description: Atomic read/write of notes in a JSON file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist.
acceptance: src/storage.ts exists with load() and save(notes) functions
save() is atomic (write to temporary file + rename)
load() returns [] if the file does not exist
tests/storage.test.ts covers the 3 previous cases

features.name: note_model
features.title: Note Model
features.description: Immutable structure representing a note with id, title, body, created_at.
acceptance: src/notes.ts exists with Note class/interface
Note.new(title, body) generates incremental id and created_at in ISO 8601
tests/notes.test.ts validates creation and serialization

features.name: cli_add_list
features.title: add and list CLI Commands
features.description: Allows adding a note and listing all existing notes.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts add 'title' --body 'text'` prints the created id
`npx tsx src/cli.ts list` prints one line per note: `<id>  <created_at>  <title>`
tests/cli.test.ts covers both commands with a temporary file

features.name: cli_show_delete
features.title: show and delete CLI Commands
features.description: Allows viewing and deleting notes by id.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts show <id>` prints title, date and body
`npx tsx src/cli.ts delete <id>` deletes and confirms with a message
Both commands return exit code != 0 if the id does not exist
tests/cli.test.ts covers success and failure

features.name: cli_search
features.title: search Command
features.description: Search by substring in title or body (case-insensitive).
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts search 'word'` lists the notes containing the word
If no matches, exit code 1 and clear message
tests/cli.test.ts covers match, no-match, and case-insensitivity

features.name: cli_edit
features.title: edit Command
features.description: Allows modifying the title and/or body of an existing note by id.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts edit <id> --title 'new'` updates only the title
`npx tsx src/cli.ts edit <id> --body 'new'` updates only the body
Passing both flags updates both fields in the same call
If no flag is passed, exit code != 0 and clear message
If id does not exist, exit code != 0 and message in stderr
tests/cli.test.ts covers success (each flag and combined), non-existent id, and absence of flags

features.name: cli_recent
features.title: recent Command
features.description: Lists the N most recent notes, sorted by created_at descending.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts recent` lists the 5 most recent notes by default
`npx tsx src/cli.ts recent --limit 10` allows changing the number
Sorting is by `created_at` from most recent to oldest
Each line follows the format `<id>\t<created_at>\t<title>` (same as `list`)
If there are no notes, exit code 0 and prints nothing (consistent with `list`)
If `--limit` is <= 0, exit code != 0 and clear message in stderr
tests/cli.test.ts covers: default order, custom limit, empty file, invalid limit

features.name: migrate_agents_to_opencode
features.title: Migrate agents to OpenCode
features.description: Migrate the project to use OpenCode instead of Claude.
acceptance: OpenCode provider is used instead of Claude Code
AGENTS.md reflects this change
OpenCode can read properly all the instructions that are currently inside .opencode folder

features.name: cli_count
features.title: count Command
features.description: Shows how many notes are stored.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts count` prints a single integer: the total number of notes
If no notes, prints `0`
The command does not modify the notes file
tests/cli.test.ts covers: empty file and file with several notes

features.name: cli_export
features.title: Markdown export Command
features.description: Exports all notes to a human-readable Markdown file.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts export <path>` writes all notes in `<path>` in Markdown format
Each note appears as a section with level 2 title (`## <title>`), a line with `created_at`, and the body as a paragraph
Notes are sorted by `id` ascending in the export
If destination path already exists, exit code != 0 and clear message in stderr (do not overwrite by default)
Passing `--force` allows overwriting an existing file
tests/cli.test.ts covers: export to new path, attempt to overwrite without `--force`, overwrite with `--force`

features.name: cli_stats
features.title: stats Command
features.description: Shows aggregated statistics about stored notes.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts stats` prints: total number of notes, oldest note date, newest note date, average body length (integer, in characters)
Format is one `key: value` pair per line
If no notes, exit code 0 and a single message `no notes` to stdout
The command does not modify the notes file
tests/cli.test.ts covers: empty file, file with a single note, file with several notes

features.name: cli_clear
features.title: clear Command (destructive)
features.description: Deletes all notes from the file. Requires explicit confirmation via flag.
acceptance: `npx tsx src/cli.ts clear` WITHOUT `--yes` prints a confirmation message, does NOT delete anything and exits with exit code != 0
`npx tsx src/cli.ts clear --yes` deletes all notes and confirms with a message like `deleted N notes`
After a successful clear, `list` prints nothing
If notes file did not exist, `clear --yes` exits with exit code 0 and reports `deleted 0 notes`
tests/cli.test.ts covers: without `--yes` (non-destructive), with `--yes` and notes present, with `--yes` and empty file
